info.title: FerroMQ HTTP API
info.description: Management API for FerroMQ (`/api/v1`). Default list responses remain bare JSON arrays; pass `?format=page` for `{ items, offset, limit, truncated, total? }`. 4xx/5xx bodies are `{ code, message, details?, request_id }`. Cluster-aggregating endpoints return HTTP 200 with per-node `{ ok, error? }` instead of a single boolean when some nodes fail.

get.summary: Swagger UI for the OpenAPI document
Basic information of every cluster node

200.description: Per-node broker objects; failed peers are ClusterNodeError
Per-node status; failed peers are ClusterNodeError

get.summary: Cluster feature flags plus consistency summary (menu gating)
get.description: `enabled` is the OR of each flag across reachable nodes and is intended for dashboard menu gating. `nodes[]` uses structured `{ ok, error? }` rather than a bare error string. Unreachable nodes increment `failed_count` and set `partial: true`.
Default body is `{ items, has_more }`. `?format=page` adds `offset`, `limit`, `truncated`, and optional `total`.

delete.summary: Delete a retained message by exact topic

post.summary: Unsubscribe a session from a topic

get.description: Default: array of `{ ok, node, plugins }` (or `{ ok: false, node, plugins: [], error }`). `?format=page` wraps the array.

get.summary: Read a plugin config (GET only in this milestone)

put.summary: Reload a plugin config from disk
Load / start a plugin on a node
Unload / stop a plugin on a node

get.description: Array of `{ ok: true, node, stats }` or `{ ok: false, node, error }`.

200.description: Per-node metrics; failed peers use `{ ok: false, node, error }`

bearerAuth.description: Required only when `http_bearer_token` is set in the plugin config.

Limit.name: _limit
Limit.description: Max rows. `0` or omitted uses plugin `max_row_limit` (default 10000).

LimitAlias.name: limit
LimitAlias.description: Alias of `_limit` (used by `/retains` as the canonical name).

Offset.name: _offset
Offset.description: Rows to skip after the backend fetch.

FormatPage.name: format
FormatPage.description: Set to `page` to wrap a list as `{ items, offset, limit, truncated, total? }` instead of a bare array. Default is the historical array body.

XRowCount.description: Number of rows in this response (`items.length` for page / retains).

XTruncated.description: `true` when the result was cut off by `_limit` / `max_row_limit`.

XRequestId.description: Correlation id. Echoed from the request header when present.

ClientList.description: Bare array by default; `{ items, ... }` when `format=page`.

SubscriptionList.description: Bare array by default; page envelope when `format=page`.

RouteList.description: Bare array by default; page envelope when `format=page`.

PluginList.description: Bare plugin array by default; page envelope when `format=page`.

code.description: Same value as the HTTP status code

total.description: Present only when the backend knows the full count

node.description: Present on stats/metrics (`{ id }`) and plugins (`integer`)

Features.description: Runtime capability flags. A flag is true when the backing implementation is loaded and enabled. Used by the dashboard for menu gating via FeaturesSummary.enabled.

retain.description: Retained messages (`ferromq-retainer`). Gates the Retains menu.
